name: chart-brush
title: Chart Brush
description: A small overview of a whole series with a window over it whose two handles are dragged or moved by arrow keys to choose the stretch another chart shows: the range is two row indexes, so it fits any chart.

meta.when: Letting people zoom a long time series to a part of it: a year of daily values shown a month at a time. Give the chart above only the rows between the two indexes. For a fixed set of periods use segmented-control or tabs; for choosing dates use date-picker.
